title: Jacob Wrestles with God at the Jabbok
description: Jacob is left alone by the river Jabbok and wrestles with a man all night. His hip is put out of joint, but he refuses to let go until he receives a blessing, and he is given the new name Israel. He names the place Peniel because he has seen God face to face.
